_note: OWNER BUILDER DECLARATION section (Owner Builder Date/Signature, and the two 'I, as owner...' checkboxes below it - not present in this mapping at all) is intentionally unmapped - it's the property owner's own first-person legal declaration, not EcoSolar's to check on their behalf, same reasoning as westminster/mapping_declaration.json. LOBBYIST ORDINANCE CERTIFICATION section (Applicant Print Name, Applicant Signature, Company Name, Date) is also unmapped - it's a conditional certification ('unincorporated LA County only') we can't universally assert is true or applicable for every job. All Signature/Date fields (Contractor Signature, Signature Of Applicant + Date, Final Signature + Date) are left blank, filled at time of signing, matching every other form's convention. Lender's Name/Address/Branch have no JNB source - left blank rather than assumed 'N/A'. 'License Class' (14pt-wide box) can only physically fit ONE class code even at an unreadably tiny font - since EcoSolar holds two classes (C10 and C46), showing only one would misrepresent its actual license scope, so left unmapped rather than showing incomplete info.
